sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Provincial Assembly Powers Immunities and Privileges Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1990
ACT I OF 1990
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY POWERS, IMMUNITIES AND PRIVILEGES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act to amend
the North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly, (Powers, Immunities and
Privileges) Act, 1988
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary, 11th January, 1990]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/90/456,
dated 11-1-1990.---TheNorth-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly
(Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 7th
January, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 10th January, 1990, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly
(Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 7th

Province on the 10th January, 1990, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of section 9 of
the N. W.F.P. Act No. IX of 1988. --In the North-West Frontier Province
Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities and Privileges) Act, 1988 (N.-W.F.P.
Act No. IX of 1988) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 9, in
clause (d), the words "in his constituency" and the words
"located within her constituency" shall be deleted and shall always
be deemed to have been so deleted.

3. Addition of section 32-A in
the N.W.F.P. Act No. IX of 1988: --In the said Act, after section 32 a new
section 32-A shall be added, namely:
"32-A.
Notwithstanding anything contained in any other Provincial Law for the time
being in force and without prejudice to the generality of the Act, the
provisions of the Act, shall override all other provisions of the Provincial
laws, if found inconsistent with the provisions of this Act.
